Services include:

• Service Coordination

• Complete intake anytime via walk-in

Shelter from the cold. If the weather is 32°F/0°C or below between 4 PM and 8 AM the next day, you may access this warming center. Drop-in staff can also make arrangements for homeless individuals at other citywide facilities. See other Code Blue service locations.

The maximum capacity for overnight at this drop-in is 60 people. A case manager can refer you to the 30th Street intake to enter the DHS shelter system. If you were assigned to a shelter in the last year, you cannot be referred elsewhere.
